verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships its own AI tooling: AgentOS, documented with an official MCP server, lets AI agents act on a production account, including building cashflow reports. Its spend product claims automated reconciliation, and the Card Expenses API can mark expenses as synced into an ERP or accounting system. No evidence shows an AI automation built for month-end close, so the story is only thinly covered. Missing for 10: a documented AI-driven reconciliation or close workflow, AI categorization or coding of transactions into accounting systems, native accounting-software integrations, and hands-on or independent evidence of faster closes.
